_about: How proposals are decided. Read by the website (scripts/build_activity.py) and the voting bot (website-forms/Voting.gs). Changing this file is a substantive change under the Governance page.

routine.label: decision: routine
routine.summary: Routine change: adopted once one Operations Committee member approves and no voting member objects.

substantive.label: decision: substantive
substantive.summary: Substantive change: adopted after a comment period of at least 14 days, once every Operations Committee member approves and a majority of the voting members who vote approve.
